## Why This Is Asked

Assesses practical Azure DevOps skills, blue/green deployment, per-environment secrets/flags, and safe rollback in a beginner-friendly scenario.

## Key Concepts

- YAML multi-stage pipelines
- Helm deployments in AKS with namespace isolation
- Azure App Configuration feature flags per environment
- Azure Key Vault secrets integration
- Traffic-switching and rollback safety
- Monitoring/logging with Azure Monitor

## Code Example

```yaml
# skeleton
trigger:
  branches:
    include:
    - main

stages:
- stage: Build
  jobs:
  - job: Build
    steps:
    - task: NodeTool@0
      inputs:
        versionSpec: '18.x'
    - script: npm install
    - script: npm test
- stage: Publish
  jobs:
  - job: BuildAndPush
    steps:
    - script: docker build -t <acr>/api:$(Build.BuildId) .
    - script: docker push <acr>/api:$(Build.BuildId)
- stage: DeployBlue
  jobs:
  - job: DeployBlue
    steps:
    - script: helm upgrade --install api-blue charts/api --namespace blue --set image.tag=$(Build.BuildId)
- stage: SmokeTest
  jobs:
  - job: Smoke
    steps:
    - script: ./scripts/smoke-test.sh
- stage: Promote
  dependsOn: SmokeTest
  condition: succeeded()
  jobs:
  - job: Promote
    steps:
    - task: ManualValidation@0
      inputs:
        instructions: 'Approve prod swap if blue is healthy'
- stage: Rollback
  dependsOn: Promote
  condition: failed()
  jobs:
  - job: Rollback
    steps:
    - script: helm upgrade --install api-green charts/api --namespace green --set image.tag=$(Build.BuildId)
```

## Follow-up Questions

- How would you handle secret rotation in this setup?
- How would you test the blue/green rollback in a CI environment?

questions.explanation:
## Why This Is Asked
This question validates the ability to combine per-tenant isolation, cost governance, and centralized telemetry management within a single automated pipeline with built-in rollback capabilities.

## Key Concepts
- Per-tenant resource scoping with dedicated resource groups, App Configuration, and Key Vault
- Tenant-specific App Service slots with isolated configuration
- Real-time cost forecasting and governance via Azure Cost Management
- Telemetry segregation using tenant-scoped Log Analytics workspaces
- Drift detection and automated rollback strategies

## Code Example
```yaml
# Azure DevOps YAML Pipeline for Multi-Tenant Onboarding
trigger: none
pr: none

parameters:
  - name: tenantId
    type: string
  - name: tenantName
    type: string
  - name: costThresholdUSD
    type: number
    default: 500

stages:
  - stage: PreValidation
    jobs:
      - job: CostForecastGate
        steps:
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            name: CheckCostForecast
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: 'Azure-SP-Naming-Conv'
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                # Query Cost Management for 30-day forecast
                COST=$(az cost management query \
                  --scope /subscriptions/$SUBSCRIPTION_ID \
                  --query "properties[0].columns[?(@.name=='Cost')].rows[0]" \
                  --timeframe ThisMonth \
                  --dataset-name CurrentMonth \
                  -o tsv)
                
                PROJECTED=$(( COST * 30 / $(date +%d) ))
                
                if [ $PROJECTED -gt ${{ parameters.costThresholdUSD }} ]; then
                  echo "##vso[task.logissue type=error]Projected cost \$$PROJECTED exceeds threshold \$${{ parameters.costThresholdUSD }}"
                  exit 1
                fi

  - stage: ProvisionResources
    dependsOn: PreValidation
    jobs:
      - job: CreateTenantResources
        steps:
          - task: AzureResourceGroupDeployment@3
            name: ProvisionRG
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: 'Azure-SP-Naming-Conv'
              resourceGroupName: 'rg-${{ parameters.tenantName }}'
              location: 'East US'
              templateLocation: 'Inline'
              mode: 'Incremental'

          - task: AzureCLI@2
            name: ProvisionAppConfig
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: 'Azure-SP-Naming-Conv'
              scriptType: 'bash'
              inlineScript: |
                az appconfig create \
                  --name "appconfig-${{ parameters.tenantName }}" \
                  --resource-group "rg-${{ parameters.tenantName }}" \
                  --location "East US"

          - task: AzureCLI@2
            name: ProvisionKeyVault
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: 'Azure-SP-Naming-Conv'
              scriptType: 'bash'
              inlineScript: |
                az keyvault create \
                  --name "kv-${{ parameters.tenantName }}" \
                  --resource-group "rg-${{ parameters.tenantName }}" \
                  --location "East US"

          - task: AzureCLI@2
            name: CreateLogAnalytics
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: 'Azure-SP-Naming-Conv'
              scriptType: 'bash'
              inlineScript: |
                az monitor log-analytics workspace create \
                  --workspace-name "la-${{ parameters.tenantName }}" \
                  --resource-group "rg-${{ parameters.tenantName }}" \
                  --location "East US"

  - stage: DeployAppService
    dependsOn: ProvisionResources
    jobs:
      - job: DeploySlot
        steps:
          - task: AzureAppServiceSettings@1
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: 'Azure-SP-Naming-Conv'
              appName: 'saas-api-${{ parameters.tenantName }}'
              slotName: 'staging'
              appSettings: |
                TENANT_ID=${{ parameters.tenantId }}
                APP_CONFIG_ENDPOINT=https://appconfig-${{ parameters.tenantName }}.azconfig.io
                KEY_VAULT_URI=https://kv-${{ parameters.tenantName }}.vault.azure.net/
                LOG_ANALYTICS_WORKSPACE_ID=$(az monitor log-analytics workspace show --workspace-name la-${{ parameters.tenantName }} --resource-group rg-${{ parameters.tenantName }} --query customerId -o tsv)

          - task: AzureAppServiceManage@0
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: 'Azure-SP-Naming-Conv'
              Action: 'Swap Slots'
              WebAppName: 'saas-api-${{ parameters.tenantName }}'
              SourceSlot: 'staging'

  - stage: ValidateAndMonitor
    dependsOn: DeployAppService
    jobs:
      - job: HealthCheck
        steps:
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            name: VerifyTenantAccess
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: 'Azure-SP-Naming-Conv'
              scriptType: 'bash'
              inlineScript: |
                # Verify Key Vault access policy and App Configuration keys
                az keyvault secret list --vault-name "kv-${{ parameters.tenantName }}" | jq 'length'
                az appconfig kv list --name "appconfig-${{ parameters.tenantName }}" | jq 'length'

          - task: PublishPipelineArtifact@1
            inputs:
              targetPath: '$(System.DefaultWorkingDirectory)'
              artifact: 'tenant-config-${{ parameters.tenantId }}'
```

## Testing Strategy

questions.explanation:
## Why This Is Asked
This question assesses end-to-end continuous deployment skills, safe production gating strategies, and integration with Azure's configuration and secrets management services. It ensures you can model deployment slots, implement lightweight load tests, and configure rollback paths in a beginner-friendly pipeline context.

## Key Concepts
- Azure DevOps YAML pipelines and staging strategies
- Azure Functions deployment slots for zero-downtime deployments
- App Configuration for per-environment settings
- Key Vault integration via managed identity for secrets
- Load testing with k6 for performance validation
- Gate-based promotion with latency and error rate thresholds
- Azure Monitor Logs for pipeline diagnostics

## Code Example
```yaml
trigger:
  - main

variables:
  azureServiceConnection: 'azure-sp'
  functionAppName: 'my-function-app'
  appConfigName: 'my-app-config'
  keyVaultName: 'my-key-vault'

stages:
  - stage: Build
    jobs:
      - job: Build
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        steps:
          - task: NodeTool@0
            inputs:
              versionSpec: '18.x'
          - script: npm install
          - script: npm run build
          - publish: $(System.DefaultWorkingDirectory)/dist
            artifact: drop

  - stage: Test_Audit
    dependsOn: Build
    jobs:
      - job: Test_and_Lint
        steps:
          - task: NodeTool@0
            inputs:
              versionSpec: '18.x'
          - script: npm install
          - script: npm run lint
          - script: npm test
      - job: Security_Audit
        steps:
          - task: NodeTool@0
            inputs:
              versionSpec: '18.x'
          - script: npm install
          - script: npm audit --audit-level=moderate

  - stage: Deploy_Staging
    dependsOn: Test_Audit
    variables:
      environment: 'staging'
    jobs:
      - deployment: DeployToStaging
        environment: 'staging'
        strategy:
          runOnce:
            deploy:
              steps:
                - task: AzureKeyVault@1
                  inputs:
                    azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
                    KeyVaultName: $(keyVaultName)
                    SecretsFilter: '*'
                - task: AzureAppConfiguration@1
                  inputs:
                    azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
                    AppConfigurationEndpoint: 'https://$(appConfigName).azconfig.io'
                    labels: 'staging'
                - task: AzureFunctionApp@1
                  inputs:
                    azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
                    appType: 'functionApp'
                    appName: $(functionAppName)
                    deploySlot: true
                    slotName: 'staging'
                    package: '$(Pipeline.Workspace)/dist/*.zip'

  - stage: Load_Test
    dependsOn: Deploy_Staging
    jobs:
      - job: Run_k6
        steps:
          - task: k6LoadTest@1
            inputs:
              filePath: 'tests/load-test.js'
             vus: '50'
              duration: '30s'
              threshold: 'p95=1200,error_rate=1'

  - stage: Promote_or_Rollback
    dependsOn: Load_Test
    jobs:
      - job: Check_conditions
        steps:
          - task: PowerShell@2
            inputs:
              targetType: 'inline'
              script: |
                $metrics = @{
                  p95Latency = 1150
                  errorRate = 0.5
                }
                if ($metrics.p95Latency -lt 1200 -and $metrics.errorRate -lt 1) {
                  Write-Host "Promoting to production"
                } else {
                  Write-Host "##vso[task.logissue type=error]Promote conditions not met"
                  exit 1
                }
      - job: Promote_to_Production
        dependsOn: Check_conditions
        condition: succeeded()
        steps:
          - task: AzureFunctionApp@1
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              appType: 'functionApp'
              appName: $(functionAppName)
              deploySlot: true
              slotName: 'staging'
              swapWithProduction: true
      - job: Rollback_on_Failure
        dependsOn: Check_conditions
        condition: failed()
        steps:
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                az functionApp deployment slot swap \
                  --resource-group my-rg \
                  --name $(functionAppName) \
                  --slot staging \
                  --target-slot production
          - task: AzureMonitor@1
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              alertsToSearch: 'all'
              insightsToSearch: 'all'
```

questions.explanation:
## Why This Is Asked
This evaluates knowledge of ephemeral PR environments, Azure DevOps pipelines, and Infrastructure as Code orchestration patterns.

## Key Concepts
- PR-triggered pipeline automation
- Azure Container Instances for temporary environments
- Azure Key Vault and App Configuration integration
- Health monitoring and drift detection
- Cost-conscious cleanup strategies and centralized logging

## Code Example
```yaml
# Example skeleton (illustrates core structure)
trigger:
  none
pr:
  autoCancel: true
jobs:
- job: PRPreview
  displayName: 'PR Preview Environment'
  pool:
    vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
  steps:
  - task: AzureCLI@2
    inputs:
      azureSubscription: '<service-connection>'
      scriptType: 'bash'
      scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
      inlineScript: |
        # Provision ACI with unique name
        az container create \
          --name api-pr-$(System.PullRequest.PullRequestNumber) \
          --resource-group <resource-group> \
          --image <acr-repo>/api:pr-$(Build.BuildId)
```

questions.explanation:
## Why This Is Asked
Tests ability to combine policy governance, drift detection, and multi-region release orchestration within Azure DevOps. It probes rollback reliability and disaster-recovery readiness under real-world constraints.

## Key Concepts
- Azure DevOps YAML pipelines
- Helm-based deployments to AKS (multi-region)
- Azure Key Vault per-environment secrets
- Azure Policy for Kubernetes governance
- Post-deploy drift detection with kubectl diff
- Automatic Helm rollback and traffic pause
- Disaster-recovery drills and cost controls

## Code Example
```yaml
# Minimal illustration of a multi-region helm upgrade with diff check
stages:
  - stage: Deploy
    jobs:
      - job: prod
        steps:
          - task: HelmDeploy@0
            inputs:
              connectionType: 'Kubernetes' # placeholder
              namespace: 'default'
              release: 'service'
              chartType: 'FilePath'
              chartPath: './charts/service'
              valueFile: './charts/service/values.yaml'
          - script: kubectl diff -R -k manifests
```

## Follow-up Questions
- How would you handle secret rotation without redeploying to all regions?
- How would you measure drift significance and decide when to rollback vs. escalate?
